result:
Summary: HotpotQA employs rigorous evaluation protocols to assess multi-hop question answering systems across distractor and full wiki settings. The benchmark includes 112,779 Wikipedia-based Q&A pairs annotated with sentence-level supporting facts. Baseline performance statistics show 44–45 / 58–59 Answer EM/F1, 22 / 66 Supporting Fact EM/F1, and 11–12 / 40–41 Joint EM/F1 in the distractor setting, and 25 / 34 Answer EM/F1, 5 / 41 Supporting Fact EM/F1, and 2.6 / 17.8 Joint EM/F1 in the full wiki setting. The evaluation methods include Hits@10 for the IR system, EM and F1 scores for the end-to-end model, and the use of supporting facts to justify answers.
